title: [GMCP 203.023.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Service adapters and generated MCP surfaces
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-023-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, command and native-library adapters can generate reviewable MCP tools/resources with stable names, precise schemas, pagination, auth mapping, rate limits, idempotency and redaction. Generated artifacts are reproducible, diffable and policy-scanned; unsupported semantics fail generation rather than producing unsafe generic shells. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
